title: kb_pack and rag.py pack print a pack handle that a later call can name, and the mcp capture row keeps it
goal: rag.py pack and kb_pack print one line 'pack: P-<8 hex>', the hash of the questions, the pack arguments and the kb commit, so the same pack on the same commit gives the same handle on every server, stdio and kb_http.py alike, with no session; the server keeps handle -> {questions, printed lines, commit} under _cache/ for a bounded time and count (never committed); the mcp and kb_hook capture rows store the handle (ql_capture.pack_lines reads it), so distill can join a report to its lookup exactly; rag.py eval keeps passing every row and the eval's mean pack size grows by under 1%.
